sections.heading: What is trending: “the witcher 3 remastered”
paragraphs: “the witcher 3 remastered” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for GB (snapshot taken 2026-09-28T15:27:03+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 500 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from IGN, Pure Xbox, Push Square. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “CD Projekt Releases Official List of All the Improvements in The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered” — IGN
“Here's What The Witcher 3 Remastered Looks Like On Xbox Series X|S” — Pure Xbox
“The Witcher 3 Remastered a 45GB PS5 Patch, Release Times Revealed” — Push Square

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Mon, 28 Sep 2026 06:40:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-09-28T15:27:03+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-09-28T15:28:37+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.

faq.a: Google's Trending Now feed links the spike to coverage from IGN, Pure Xbox, Push Square. faq.q: How many people searched for “the witcher 3 remastered”?
faq.a: Google reports at least 500 searches in GB as of the feed snapshot. This is a published lower bound, not an exact count.
This snapshot covers GB. The same term may trend differently in other regions.
